transcriber_notes: 712x770 JPEG screenshot of a SnowPro-style Windows form (French labels), no app branding -> source_format 'other'. Height axis has a discontinuity near 100 cm (the '100' label is half missing, no 100 cm gridline, 110 and 90 cm gridlines only 46 px apart instead of 54, temperature line kinks there): heights read with the local scale on each side (2.70 px/cm; above: 150 cm at y=300; below: 0 at y=697). No boundary falls inside the discontinuity (the 118-79 cm bar and its table row are continuous). Boundaries 141/118/79/72/64/50/30/29/24/23/0 from blue bar edges and the table leader lines (+-0.5 cm); 30-29 and 24-23 are ~1 cm thin layers. Hardness axis geometric (bars grow leftward from the right edge x=332): F/4F/1F/P/K at 13/27/54/108/216 px; bar widths 13 (F), 47 (1F-), 54 (1F), 67 (1F+), 108 (P), 148 (P+); +/- confirmed by the marks under the R-column hardness symbols. '=' read as IFrc per the guide table. Temperature axis 13.5 px/C, 0 C at x=305 (0 label gridline); circle markers read to +-0.1 C; 141 cm reading (-13.0) matches the printed surface temperature and the dashed air-temperature line ends at -11.3 (printed -11.2, not recorded as snow temperature). No marker at 100 cm or below 30 cm. No tests or remarks; theta (moisture) and HW/rho columns blank.
